channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: Lyft's stock plummets 16% as a disappointing quarter presents a setback for its comeback story
item.description: Lyft's stock fell 16% in after-hours trading Tuesday after the company posted an operating loss for 2025.

item.title: Elon Musk's xAI loses second cofounder in 48 hours
item.description: Jimmy Ba left the company one day after the departure of Tony Wu, another cofounder at Elon Musk's AI company.

item.title: NBC's Super Bowl ratings just miss record — but Bad Bunny was the top draw
item.description: Telemundo, however, did deliver a record with the most-watched Super Bowl in US Spanish-language history with an average of 3.3 million viewers.

item.title: The police have detained a person for questioning on the disappearance of Savanna Guthrie's mom
item.description: The Pima County Sheriff's Department said the subject was detained during a traffic stop south of Tucson.

item.title: Tech bull Dan Ives says Wall Street's software skepticism is 'the most disconnected call that I've ever seen'
item.description: Dan Ives says Wall Street is underestimating software's role in the AI boom, calling the skepticism "disconnected."

item.title: Olympic skier Ben Ogden, 25, credits a soothing hobby for helping him relax after winning silver
item.description: Ben Ogden won silver at the Milan Cortina Games, ending a 50-year Olympic medal drought for the US in men's cross-country skiing.

item.title: Power banks, body warmers, and antifreeze: Ukrainian troops tell us how they survive deep winter out in the trenches
item.description: For Ukrainian infantry and drone teams, the extreme cold brings new challenges to modern war in the trenches.

item.title: Robinhood's CEO says we're on the cusp of a 'prediction market supercycle'
item.description: Vlad Tenev said that prediction markets could drive "trillions in annual volume over time."

item.title: Kyiv says Russian troops need Starlink so badly they're trying to get Ukrainians to register terminals for them
item.description: Officials said they've learned of multiple instances where Russian troops have tried to threaten or pay Ukrainians to register such terminals.

item.title: Marriott said it lost $23 million in letting go of Sonder
item.description: Marriott ended its partnership with Sonder in November, and Sonder filed for Chapter 7 bankruptcy soon after.
